productionBaselineEvidence: Source baseline at initial branch point: GitHub main 5efb99435243a4bcaeff27fc8d41d58b6a9969c2. Prior official AdMob month-open snapshot from Nov 8 verified in repo scope records: estimated gross ₱8.64, 16 qualified accounts / 702 QMP, 30% provisionally designated pool; NOT a current daily revenue figure. Existing BUKLOD AdMob native surfaces, 2-action interstitial lock, consent/viewport gating and 2026-11-07 ad restoration scope were inspected. Production EAS env density variables, compiled release, Android visual fill and live OTA fingerprint are NOT verified.
chosenApproach: Reuse central Android platform-specific feed cadence and existing NativeAd/first-view components. Increase organic spacing only to bounded high-traffic values; add one extra mid native opportunity on high-traffic dashboards, footer banners where absent, Connect inbox row-native ad, and Reels nearby preload. Tighten Reels consent and passive route gating so additional requests honor the same controls. No backend or native dependency modification. Restore a sibling IGPAT action in the public Wall header rather than changing persistent bottom navigation. Preserve account/mode-scoped signed IGPAT feed rows in a bounded session-only eight-minute cache, retain a playable feed through failed reload, use Data Saver or degraded-network bandwidth limits, suppress next-video preloading on weak signal, and automatically retry on actual recovery to online. Extend the central naturally completed workflow list, allow only exact successful Kingdom/Reels completion placements through their otherwise sensitive routes, mount separate viewport-gated passive inventory on noninteractive Kingdom and Points views, and defer Character Studio ads until the editing modal unmounts.
selectionRationale: AdMob eCPM does not justify hundreds of forced ads per user. Maximize real viewable opportunities with media native and placement diversity rather than unsafe every-action interstitials, direct sponsor sales or synthetic impressions. Reusing tested inventory minimizes RC native compatibility risk and preserves publisher controls. Public Wall already had a static COMMUNITY header; inserting IGPAT there matches the requested visual location without stealing a bottom tab or blocking tap on network reads. IGPAT's old reload path returned a full-screen spinner and erased rows on fetch failure despite existing playable media; short-lived scoped warm cache fixes that failure while respecting signed URL expiry.
